Hello Liz,
Thank you for confirmation.
There can be several factors that cause an OCPP connection to go offline.
Some of the most common reasons include:
Network latency or instability, either from the server side or the charge point side.
Server-side issues, such as temporary downtime, high load, or maintenance activities.
Momentary disruptions, which have been observed during specific time windows, possibly due to transient network or system conditions.
Thank you
Best Regards
